'''2000 DragonCon Death Star II Pre-Release''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held in DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia on 1 July 2000. It is known from Walter Cowart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d962">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-by-walterd962/ dragoncon-by-walter], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-by-walterd962/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 DragonCon Open]].

* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
